# Test audio output file creation
env OPENAI_API_KEY=test-key-123

# Create a test WAV file
mkwav test_input.wav 500

# Run oairt with audio output file (it will fail to connect but should create the file)
! oairt -api-key test-key-123 -audio-output output.pcm -debug 1
stderr 'timeout waiting for initial session'

# Check that the output file was created
assert exists output.pcm
